Name: Nicole - Custom Genshin Impact NPC
Author: Sonix817
Description:
[center][quote][i]Mage N, Nicole Reeyn. In summary: "The observer of the World." ,  The Silent "Mage," the Voiceless "Angel."[/i][/quote][left]
[center][b]Main Features :[/b][/center]

✦ 12 heart events,
✦ i18n compatibility,
✦ her own garden, home, spouse patio and room,
✦ over 200 lines of dialogue,
✦ custom portraits and sprites,
✦ her own quest,
✦ ... and much, much more!

[center][b]Requirements :[/b][/center]

To install this mod you will need :
[i]- SMAPI,
- Content Patcher[/i]

Here is what you should do after making sure you have everything downloaded!
[i]- Unpack the mod file,
- Place it in your "Mods" folder,
- Run the game using SMAPI.[/i]

[center][b]Notes :[/b][/center]
[/left]
[/center]
The mod has a README file where you can find her schedule, gift tastes and info about events and more! 

If you find any errors, please let me know! Make sure to include as much details as possible - season, time, day, hours and ideally your SMAPI log if possible.

All the sprites, portraits and furniture was custom made by me for this mod. Do not use it for your own project without permission.

Huge thanks to my friends and everyone who helped me develop this mod! <3
